title: 💰 Periodic Labour Force Survey — 4.8% Unemployment Rate & 56.1% LFPR in December 2025
summary: LFPR for age 15+ reached 56.1% in Dec 2025 (female LFPR 35.3%, worker population ratio 53.4%). Overall unemployment stood at 4.8%; urban female unemployment dropped to 9.1%.
